known.title: Gate: default Claude read effort uses an unsupported SDK message
Gate: Claude read process-tree shutdown is not exercised

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a Claude cold read has no configured grill model or effort.
This replacement injects `effort` into the SDK init message, but Anthropic documents that application init messages omit that field ([SDK reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/typescript#sdksystemmessage)). The previous reader explicitly requested applied settings; the new driver does not. With effort unset, `repo.claude_output` (src/forge/repo.py:506–521) therefore never learns it, leaving live status and run records without the effective effort while this test passes. Preserve the applied-effort behavior and make the stub reflect the actual SDK contract.
findings.title: Gate: default Claude read effort uses an unsupported SDK message

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a user stops an active external Claude cold read.
The read case returns here before the process-tree shutdown assertions. Those assertions only launch `host.start("work", ITEM)` at line 277, so they cannot verify the separate read launcher. Removing `machine.agent_process` from `_sdk_read` would leave the new read cases passing despite breaking the promised clean stop. Extend the read case to hold the SDK driver and its child, stop the read through Forge, and verify both processes exit and no completed read is accepted.
